title: Simulacro Tarea 3: Organización territorial y geografía física y política (2 preguntas)

words.translation: Mount Teide (3,718 m volcano in Tenerife; highest peak in Spain)
Mount Mulhacén (3,479 m in Sierra Nevada, Granada; highest peak on the mainland)
Tagus River (longest river on the Iberian Peninsula; flows through Toledo into the Atlantic)
Ebro River (highest-flow river in Spain; flows into the Mediterranean in Tarragona)
the Pyrenees mountain range (natural border with France and Andorra)
the Central Plateau (divided by the Sistema Central into Submeseta Norte and Sur)
single-province autonomous community (Asturias, Cantabria, La Rioja, Navarra, Madrid, Murcia, Baleares)
National Park (16 in Spain, such as Doñana, Picos de Europa, Teide, Timanfaya, Ordesa)
